title: hqb-unet-ablation: Source code for the parameter-matched ablation of a quantum-bottleneck U-Net
description: Source code of the manuscript "A quantum circuit in a hybrid U-Net adds no measurable benefit over a parameter-matched classical layer in mammogram segmentation": the qseg package and, from v2.0.0, all notebooks, scripts, prespecified protocols and statistical analyses of the revised manuscript (folder paper_v2). No images, masks, weights or patient identifiers are included.
